# main { #tvbo.api.main }

`api.main`

FastAPI application exposing the TVBO ontology and simulation experiment endpoints.

Defines the top-level `app`, wires in the network, dynamics, and experiment sub-routers, and provides ontology search/query endpoints plus routes to configure and run [`SimulationExperiment`](/api/classes/experiment.qmd) instances.

### SimulationMetadata { #tvbo.api.main.SimulationMetadata }

```python
api.main.SimulationMetadata()
```

Legacy request payload describing a simulation configuration.

Retained for backwards compatibility with clients that submit the model, connectivity, coupling, and integration blocks separately rather than as a single experiment dictionary.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type   | Description                                  | Default    |
|--------------|--------|----------------------------------------------|------------|
| model        |        | Dynamics/model configuration block.          | _required_ |
| connectivity |        | Optional network connectivity configuration. | _required_ |
| coupling     |        | Optional coupling configuration.             | _required_ |
| integration  |        | Optional integration scheme configuration.   | _required_ |

### configure_experiment { #tvbo.api.main.configure_experiment }

```python
api.main.configure_experiment(metadata=Body(...))
```

Configure a simulation experiment from legacy metadata.

Passes the submitted metadata to the ontology API to set up a simulation experiment.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type               | Description                              | Default     |
|----------|--------------------|------------------------------------------|-------------|
| metadata | SimulationMetadata | Legacy simulation configuration payload. | `Body(...)` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | A confirmation message that the experiment was configured. |

### run_experiment { #tvbo.api.main.run_experiment }

```python
api.main.run_experiment(request=Body(...))
```

Run a simulation experiment and return the results.

The experiment dict should match the YAML schema and is passed directly to SimulationExperiment for initialization.
